retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key portrait centered in a textured black field, framed by a thick cyan border with primary yellow and secondary cyan typography.
triggerTerms: low-key portrait with textured black background

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central, dimly lit portrait emerging from a deep black, linen-textured background. The entire scene is enclosed in a solid cyan frame. Typography is organized with a large, yellow, italicized serif name at the top and a right-aligned tracklist in mixed yellow and cyan sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Cyan border containing a dark textured field
Yellow display type contrasting against black
Right-aligned vertical text block balancing central subject
coreInvariants: Linen-like canvas texture over the black background
Low-key lighting hitting only the subject's face and shoulders

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, medium-close shot, appearing to emerge from the bottom third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit face of the subject and the large yellow header text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left header, down to the central face, then right to the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subject, creating a moody, intimate atmosphere.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black background and the bright yellow/cyan elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast transitional serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display name uses sharp, high-contrast serifs with a significant italic slant
Secondary text uses clean, monolinear sans-serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for branding paired with a functional sans-serif for information.

preserve: Italic slant of the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif and elegant slant of the header.
Matches the utilitarian feel of the tracklist typography.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a person emerging from a deep black background with a visible linen canvas texture. Add a thick, solid cyan border around the entire square frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, golden-yellow italicized serif name at the top. Add a right-aligned list of text in the middle-right area, alternating between golden-yellow and cyan colors using a clean sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the main header italicized and yellow?

postGenerationChecks: Check for linen texture consistency across the black field
Ensure the cyan border is perfectly uniform
Verify the italic slant of the display type is consistent
Confirm the subject is properly integrated into the shadows
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key portrait + linen texture + cyan frame + yellow italic serif header + right-aligned sans-serif list.
